record.one_liner: Document parsing, data extraction, and document modification API platform utilizing advanced vision language models.

access_test.quote: 1 Create a Reducto account Sign up for a free account without leaving the docs.

api_breadth.quote: Now that you can parse documents, explore the other Reducto endpoints: /extract Define a JSON schema and extract specific fields from your documents. /split Divide long documents into sections based on content type. /edit Fill PDF forms and modify DOCX documents programmatically. /parse (async) Process documents asynchronously with webhooks for high-volume workloads.

official_mcp.quote: For MCP, install once with uvx mcp-server-reducto --login , then ask the agent to call parse_document(document_url="https://cdn.reducto.ai/samples/fidelity-example.pdf") .
